items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Paul Bar Marvin as being in the band in 1928/1929, but the interviewee (J.C. Higginbotham) does not respond to confirm personal interaction or relationship.

ctx.x: Who else was in that -- that was in 1928 you said?
Yeah, in 1928, first of 1929. Yeah, we had Paul Bar Marvin on drums and Afs Foster on bass and Luis Russell.
That was with King Oliver or that was with -- was that King Oliver's band?
